name: Sadie Shimmin
bio: Sadie Shimmin is an actress, known for Wallander (2008), Mr Selfridge (2013) and The Nativity (2010).

credits.title: The Education of Jane Cumming
credits.overview: Edinburgh, 1810. Two female teachers find themselves at the centre of a scandal when one of their pupils accuses them of having a love affair.

credits.title: Borne
credits.overview: When Kate, an isolated and vulnerable young mother struggling to make ends meet, is offered help by her neighbour Marie, she finds herself pulled into a community that may not be as virtuous as it seems.
